Gold Li Holdings Berhad is a property developer specialising in landed residential developments across Muar, Tangkak and Batu Pahat, Johor. The Group has about 47.3 acres across 29 land parcels in Johor, comprising 17 owned parcels and 12 parcels under joint development with third party landowners. Moving forward, the Group plans to strengthen its presence across Muar, Tangkak and Batu Pahat, expand its landbank through acquisitions and joint ventures, and undertake its first high rise residential development in Muar, expected to commence in 2027.
 
Gold Li Holdings Berhad is set to debut on the ACE Market under the Property sector on 18 May 2026. Read the prospectus on Bursa Malaysia website or check out the IPO factsheet at https://bit.ly/IPO_GoldLi

**🧾**** What “national debt” actually means**

This is not a credit card bill that a country has to pay off tomorrow. It’s the total amount a government has borrowed over time to fund spending beyond its tax income.

In practice, it works through bonds. Governments issue debt, investors buy it, and in return they get interest. That includes banks, funds, pension systems, and often the country’s own central bank.

The key point is not the size alone, but who holds it and how manageable it is. Strong economies can carry large debt because there is constant demand for their bonds and trust in their system.

So the number itself looks scary, but the real question is always the same: **can they keep rolling it and servicing it without breaking confidence.**

Researchers at **MIT** created a moving spherical dodecahedron robot using twelve detached **Labubu** figurine heads, naming it **Labububot**.

The project challenges typical social robot design, which aims to be cute and friendly to avoid the "uncanny valley"-a discomfort zone where robots look almost human but feel unsettling.

Instead, the team leans on monster theory, suggesting a robot that causes slight unease can engage users more deeply by provoking thought rather than comfort.

They shared full assembly instructions and files on **GitHub** for those interested in building their own version.

📌 *10 Perkara Yang Akan Berkuatkuasa Mulai 1 Jun 2026* 

1. *SPPP - Skim Perniagaan Prihatin Percuma* 

Skim Pendaftaran Perniagaan Percuma (SPPP) di bawah Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia (SSM) kini menawarkan pengecualian fi pendaftaran perniagaan (sehingga RM120) untuk tempoh 2 tahun (berbanding 1 tahun sebelum ini), berkuatkuasa 1 Jun 2026.
Skim ini layak dipohon oleh usahawan B40 dan pelajar sepenuh masa di IPT, politeknik, kolej, serta institut/pusat kemahiran.
Rujuk : https://ecentral.my/daftar-ssm-percuma/

2. *LINDUNG 24 Jam* 
Skim Kemalangan Bukan Bencana Kerja (LINDUNG 24 Jam) PERKESO berkuatkuasa secara rasmi pada 1 Jun 2026. Skim ini melindungi pekerja sepanjang masa, termasuk di luar waktu bekerja dan semasa cuti, bagi kemalangan yang tidak berkaitan dengan pekerjaan.
https://www.facebook.com/ecentral.myy/posts/skim-lindung-24-jam-perkeso-diwajibkan-untuk-semua-pekerja-mulai-1-jun-2026-ini-/1509992783845897/

Akta Sewa Beli (Pindaan) 2026 berkuat kuasa pada 1 Jun, membawa pembaharuan terbesar dalam industri pembiayaan kenderaan Malaysia. Perubahan utama ini bertujuan meningkatkan ketelusan dan mengelakkan pengguna daripada membayar faedah berlebihan. Antara penambahbaikan terlibat ialah pemansuhan Rule of 78 & Pengenalan Kaedah Reducing Balance.
https://ecentral.my/akta-sewa-beli-pindaan-2026/

 *4. MyKad Baru* 
Kerajaan akan memperkenalkan MyKad versi baharu dengan 53 ciri keselamatan yang dinaik taraf (termasuk kod QR) mulai 1 Jun. Anda tidak perlu berpusu-pusu ke kaunter Jabatan Pendaftaran Negara (JPN) kerana kad lama masih sah digunakan. Pertukaran adalah tidak wajib dan boleh dibuat mengikut keselesaan atau keperluan anda.
https://ecentral.my/mykad-baru-2026/

 *5. Rebat Solar* 
Kerajaan Malaysia menawarkan rebat tunai sehingga RM3000 di bawah program SuRIA Home (Sustainable Rebate and Incentive Assistance) bermula 1 Jun sehingga 31 Disember 2026 untuk pemasangan solar bumbung kediaman.
https://ecentral.my/suria-home-rebat-solar/

 *6. ONSA* 
Dua kod baharu di bawah ONSA akan mula berkuat kuasa 1 Jun 2026 bagi memperkukuh keselamatan kanak-kanak dan pengguna rentan dalam talian. 
Kod CPC dan RMC turut menetapkan tanggungjawab lebih tegas kepada platform digital dalam menangani kandungan memudaratkan serta memperkukuh mekanisme perlindungan pengguna.
Rujuk : https://ecentral.my/media-sosial-16-tahun/

Pelaksanaan adunan biodiesel B15 bermula 1 Jun 2026 adalah langkah strategik memperkukuh keselamatan tenaga negara tanpa menjejaskan eksport minyak sawit berkenaan.
B15 mengurangkan kebergantungan kepada diesel fosil import dan menggalakkan penggunaan tenaga alternatif yang lebih mampan
Rujuk : https://berita.rtm.gov.my/fokus/fakta-visual/senarai-berita-fokus/fakta-visual/senarai-artikel/biodiesel-b15-sokong-keselamatan-tenaga-industri-sawit-dan-agenda-hijau-negara/

📌ULANGKAJI : Cara Menunaikan Solat Sunat Hari Raya Aidiladha

i) Rakaat Pertama

1. Mulai dengan lafaz takbiratul ihram, dengan menyebut Allahu Akbar disertakan dengan niat solat aidiladha di dalam hati.
2. Membaca doa iftitah.
3. Lafaz takbir 7 kali diselangseli dengan tasbih.
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
4. Membaca surah Al-Fatihah.
5. Membaca mana-mana surah (Dicadangkan membaca surah Al-A’laa.)
6. Meneruskan solat sehingga selesai rakaat pertama.

ii) Rakaat Kedua

1. Mulai dengan lafaz takbir intiqalat (takbir permulaan rakaat kedua).
2. Lafaz takbir lima kali diselangseli dengan tasbih.
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
3. Membaca surah Al-Fatihah.
4. Membaca mana-mana surah dari al-Quran. (Dicadangkan membaca surah Al-Ghahiyah atau Al-Ikhlas.)
5. Meneruskan solat sehingga selesai rakaat kedua.
6. Memberi salam.

Apple is reportedly working on a system that automatically locks an iPhone if it detects that the device was snatched from its owner.

The feature would use motion data and proximity signals from nearby Apple Watches. If the phone detects a sudden grab, increasing distance from the watch, and an unfamiliar location or Wi-Fi network, it can trigger additional security protections.

The goal is to stop thieves from accessing settings, passwords, or account controls on an already unlocked device.

What's interesting is that this is both a security feature and another ecosystem advantage. The more Apple devices you own, the more signals the system can use to protect them.

Android has offered a similar Theft Detection Lock feature for some time. The difference is that Apple appears to be tying the experience more closely to its broader device ecosystem.
